data.description: A shriezyx's web is coated with a supernatural toxin that numbs and deadens the nerves on contact. Any creature struck by a shriezyx's web must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or become slowed (as the slow spell) for 1 minute. Each round, a victim may attempt a new DC %1 Fortitude save to end the effect early. This toxin fades quickly from spun webs-it can only affect targets on the round the web is spun. Existing webs remain sticky and tangled, but do not have this slowing effect.
data.name: Slowing Toxin
